label: Became aware of metal halide perovskites
description: Snaith visited colleagues in Japan and learned about Miyasaka's work.

sources.quote: I first became aware of metal halide perovskites in 2009, when visiting some colleagues and collaborators in Japan.

label: Miyasaka group published first perovskite solar cell paper
description: The first paper using metal halide perovskites in solar cells was published.

sources.quote: The first paper using metal halide perovskites in solar cells had just been published by the group of Prof. Tsutomu (Tom) Miyasaka (Toin University of Yokohama, Japan).

label: Secured collaborative grant with Murakami
description: Snaith returned to the UK and got a grant to send a PhD student to Japan.

sources.quote: I subsequently returned to the UK and managed to get a collaborative grant with one of my colleagues Takurou Murakami and I sent a PhD student back to Japan to learn how to make these perovskite materials.

label: First publications on solid-state perovskite devices
description: Snaith's group published work showing 10.9% efficiency.

sources.quote: Since those first few publications in the end of 2012, starting from 2013, the research field of perovskite solar cells has absolutely exploded.
In our first publication we reported 10.9% efficiency.

label: Perovskite research field exploded
description: Publications grew from 4 in 2012 to about 60 in 2013.

label: Co-authored stability paper with Hacke
description: Snaith worked with Peter Hacke from NREL on stability standards.

sources.quote: I have had the pleasure of recently working with Peter Hacke from NREL and writing a paper on stability for perovskite solar cells.

label: Oxford PV sets world record for perovskite solar cell
description: Achieved 27.3% efficiency for perovskite on silicon.

sources.quote: The present world record for perovskite on silicon is 27.3% efficiency.
Oxford PV sets world record for perovskite solar cell , https://www.oxfordpv.com/news/oxford-pv-sets-world-record-perovskite-solar-cell (2018).
